about: Eval 2 and 3 for Photo of my meal (DT127, DT130). One entry per weighed plate. Weigh every food before the photo; the photo goes in evals/photos with the file name below. name: what you would call the food; also: other names it goes by (the read may say basmati for rice); grams: weighed; calories: kcal per 100 g from the pack or the table, when you know it (without it the plate's kcal is not checked). by: Milan or Tester 3. The first entry shows the shape; replace it.
